versions.changelog:
**Summary:** Added tab attachment and tab group management features; expanded tab commands; improved documentation.  

- Added `browser_attach_session` command to manage already open tabs and attach them to AI browser sessions.
- Added tab group management commands: `browser_tabgroup_create`, `browser_tabgroup_list`, `browser_tabgroup_get`, `browser_tabgroup_update`, `browser_tabgroup_add_tabs`, `browser_tabgroup_remove_tabs`.
- Expanded tab management with `browser_tab_reload` and `browser_get_tab_content` commands.
- Enhanced documentation, especially around session management and tab handling.
- Updated skill description and command usage instructions for clarity and completeness.

- Renamed skill from "QQBrowserUse" to "qqbrowser-use".
- Improved the session start command: added and documented support for the --initialUrl parameter, allowing direct navigation on session creation.
- Removed the "browser_download_url" command from the documentation.
- Minor enhancements and clarifications to command descriptions.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.

qqbrowser-skill 1.0.8

- Streamlined documentation: replaced and consolidated SKILL.md, removing references/commands.md and skill-card.md.
- Added references/commands-extended.md for expanded command reference details.
- Updated the command reference and core workflow to guide usage, covering all supported browser automation commands and best practices.
- Emphasized mandatory session isolation, playbook checks, and usage flow for both manual and replay automation.

- Renamed the skill from "qqbrowser-skill" to "QQBrowserUse".
- Removed the file "skill-card.md" from the repository.
- No feature or workflow changes; the skill's usage and documentation remain unchanged apart from the name update.

qqbrowser-skill 1.0.1

- Reworked documentation for more robust and reliable browser automation, with strict workflow rules and branching logic.
- Added references for commands, session lifecycle, and playbook usage to guide complex or reusable browser tasks.
- Updated core workflow: all tasks now require explicit session start/end and mandatory playbook checks before manual automation.
- Clarified use of element indices (encoded, not numeric) and enforced safe session/tab handling.
- Removed legacy documentation in favor of modular, use-case driven guides loaded only as needed.

- Renamed the skill to "QQBrowserUse" in SKILL.md.
- Updated the "name" field to "QQBrowserUse" for consistency.

## qqbrowser-skill 0.8.0

- Added new `--markdown` option to the `browser_snapshot` command for extracting clean Markdown of the page (for reading/extraction, with no element indices).
- The default `browser_snapshot` still provides page content with element indices for interaction.
- No other functional or documentation changes detected.

macOS support added.

- macOS is now listed as a supported platform.
- Installation instructions for macOS have been included.

No user-visible changes detected in version 0.7.3.

- No file changes or documentation updates were made in this release.
- General clarification on browser binary sources, ensuring alignment with official software distribution.

qqbrowser-skill v0.7.1

- Added details about Chromium binary download and verification in the Security section.
- Clarified that the Chromium binary is downloaded from official Tencent channels and verified via hash checksum.
- No functional changes to commands or skill logic.

qqbrowser-skill v0.7.0 Changelog

- Updated SKILL.md documentation for clarity and completeness.
- Expanded the "Task Completion" section to include marking tasks as incomplete.
- Added a "Help" section with command to list all available skills.
- Removed the "Chromium Binary" subsection from the Security section for brevity.

qqbrowser-skill 0.6.0

- Added explicit permissions section detailing required network and filesystem access.
- Updated documentation to include security and privacy clarifications, including storage locations for screenshots and downloads.
- No changes to commands or core functionality.

No changes detected in this version.

- Format report url.

qqbrowser-skill 0.4.0

- Added separate installation instructions for Linux (pipx) and Windows (pip), clarifying platform-specific setup.
- No changes to core functionality or commands. Documentation update only.

- Added `source` and `homepage` fields with links to PyPI and the official website in the skill metadata.
- No changes to functionality or commands.
- Documentation is otherwise unchanged.

Windows support added.

- Platform support updated: Windows is now supported in addition to Linux x86_64.
- No other feature or documentation changes detected.

- Initial release of qqbrowser-skill, a CLI tool for browser automation by AI agents.
- Supports Linux x86_64; macOS, Windows, and other architectures are not supported.
- Automate navigation, form filling, clicking, screenshots, data extraction, downloads, tab management, keyboard actions, and more.
- Core workflow uses indexed element references from periodic page snapshots.
- Extensive command set provided for browser interaction and automation scenarios.
